items.en: Handwritten notes and notes written on slides are now recognized and searchable; PDFs read before can be read again from AI settings.
items.zh: 手写笔记和课件上的手写批注现在也能识别和搜索，之前读取过的 PDF 可在 AI 设置中重新识别。

items.en: New Canvas shortcut cards open the Canvas tab's announcements, modules, assignments and more straight from a course or term overview.
items.zh: 新增 Canvas 快速入口卡片，在课程或学期概览上一键打开 Canvas 标签页里的公告、单元、作业与成绩等。

items.en: MCP clients that can see images can now view the pages of course files.
items.zh: 能看图的 MCP 客户端现在可以查看课程文件的原页面。

items.en: Picking course files now shows the course's folders and has a search box.
items.zh: 选择课程文件时按文件夹浏览，也可以直接搜索。

items.en: Link all of a program's courses to the LMS in one place, with suggested matches you can accept at once.
items.zh: 在 Program 设置里一次关联所有课程，代码一致的课程可一键全部关联。

items.en: Plugins are grouped into installed and not installed, with full descriptions and a simpler way to uninstall.
items.zh: 插件按已安装和未安装分组，显示完整简介，卸载入口更清晰。

items.en: Fixed math in answers that was shown as raw LaTeX.
items.zh: 修复回答中的数学公式显示为 LaTeX 源码的问题。
